// A raw *forav1.Offer cannot be handed to Execute: only a VerifiedOffer can.
//
// want-compile-error: cannot use raw (variable of type *forav1.Offer) as core.VerifiedOffer value in argument to client.Execute
package main

import (
	"context"

	forav1 "github.com/FORA-Protocol/protocol/gen/go/fora/v1"
	foraconnect "github.com/FORA-Protocol/protocol/sdk/go/connect"
)

func guard(client *foraconnect.Client) {
	raw := &forav1.Offer{OfferId: "forged"}
	_, _ = client.Execute(context.Background(), raw)
}

func main() { guard(nil) }
